title: Payment access control
subject: payment
summary: Who can pay, buy and sell: the payment rules in the access-control DSL, the Manage Billing role, and who holds what.

purpose.intro: Who can pay, buy and sell is decided in the access-control DSL, `shared/configs/access-control/index.ts`, never by checks in the slice. The slice asks the engine for a verdict on its two entities: `payment_account` and `product`. The payment ledger and purchases belong to an account, so a read or a write on them is proven on the account first. A company's money is held by a role, Manage Billing.

snippets.caption: typescript

reference.statement: Manage Billing (`company_billing`) sits beside Manager under the company Owner, so a company can hand its money to someone without handing them the roster. It also carries the standard reads, because a billing manager must see the members to set their allocations. The Owner holds everything its children hold.

snippets.caption: typescript

reference.statement: The same rules, read as people and pages.

claims.text: **Everyone signed in** manages their own billing, in Settings: plan, bundles, the Customer Portal, their purchases (`manage_own_billing`). Buying on the Marketplace with no organization active buys as the person.

**In a company**, the Owner and Manage Billing manage the company's plan, bundles, payments and purchases (`manage_billing_company`), its credits ([[credits-access-control|credits access control]]), and selling: onboarding, the Express dashboard, products (`create_product_company`, `manage_products_company`). Another vendor's products are invisible and refused.

**Managers and Standard members** have no billing: the sidebar doesn't show them Billing, the billing page tells them so, and they cannot buy for the company. What they may spend is on Credits, which every member sees.

**Musical projects and the platform admin organization** hold no payment permission today: they don't buy plans or bundles and don't sell. Who may sell is also limited by the catalog's `marketplace.sellerOrgTypes`.

**How the slice asks:** billing reads resolve a read scope on `payment_account`; buying, checkout and selling need an update verdict on it; creating a product is the create verdict on `product`, editing one the update verdict. Webhooks have no session and write without an access context.

reference.statement: Edit the DSL, never the slice's services.

claims.text: **Let musical projects buy:** add `manage_billing_musical_project` (entity `payment_account`, context `IN_MUSICAL_PROJECT`, the organization as target) and give it to `musical_project_owner`.

**Let another organization type sell:** add it to `marketplace.sellerOrgTypes` in [[payment-catalog|the payment catalog]], then add `create_product_<type>` and `manage_products_<type>` and give them to the role that holds its billing.
